title: 5.8.3 Lab: Move the counter onto this
description: The starter's tick() changes a local, so the number on screen stays at 1. Make the change land on `this.n` so it survives the call.

steps.title: Change this.n, not a local
steps.instructions: Run it and press **Space** a few times: the number stays at 1, because `tick()` makes a fresh local every call. Rewrite the body of `tick()` so the change lands on `this.n`. Run it again and press Space: the count should now climb 1, 2, 3, 4.
hints: Reread 5.8.1 (Reading: Three places a variable can live) if the difference between `n` and `this.n` is not clear yet.
`this.n += 1` reads the value that is still there from last time, adds one, and puts it back.

requirements.title: tick() adds 1 to this.n
requirements.description: Inside `tick()`, the change lands on `this.n` (for example `this.n += 1`), so the value survives the call. Help: 5.8.1 (Reading: Three places a variable can live)
